# EU-INC Knowledge Base (Structured Facts)

**Last updated:** 2026-03-02
**Format:** Structured facts registry. Updated weekly by LLM delta analysis.

---

## Timeline

- [2024] Mario Draghi publishes competitiveness report endorsing 28th regime concept
- [2024] Enrico Letta publishes single market report highlighting startup fragmentation
- [2025-Q3/Q4] EU-Inc petition campaign gathers 13,000+ signatures from founders and investors
- [2026-01-21] Ursula von der Leyen announces EU-Inc at Davos as official EC policy (W06)
- [2026-01-21] EU-Inc positioned as cornerstone of broader Investment Union strategy (W06)

## Legislative Status

- **Current phase:** Announced at political level. No draft legislation published yet.
- **Expected:** Legislative proposal sometime in 2026 (no specific date confirmed)
- **Commissioner responsible:** Michael McGrath (portfolio responsibility)
- **Legal basis:** "28th regime" - optional EU-level framework alongside 27 national systems
- **No EU-wide company register planned** - national registries persist (W07)

## Key Design Elements

| Feature | Detail | Source |
|---------|--------|--------|
| Incorporation speed | 48-hour digital incorporation | Davos announcement |
| System architecture | API-first, digital-native | eu-inc.org |
| Legal structure | Optional "28th regime" alongside national systems | EC announcement |
| Stock options | Harmonized ESOP framework across EU | EU-Inc manifesto |
| Employment | Cross-border employment capabilities | EU-Inc proposal |
| Registration | Single registration valid across all member states | EC announcement |
| Governance | Standardized rules optimized for startups | EU-Inc proposal |
| Company register | No EU-wide register (national registries persist) | W07 reports |

## Stakeholder Positions

| Actor | Position | Last Updated | Source |
|-------|----------|-------------|--------|
| EC / von der Leyen | Strong advocate, announced at Davos | W06 | EC speech |
| Michael McGrath | Portfolio commissioner | seed docs | EC orgchart |
| Index Ventures | Advocate, published reports | seed docs | Manifesto |
| Atomico | Supporter (State of European Tech) | seed docs | Reports |
| Factory Berlin | Startup community advocate | seed docs | Manifesto |
| BusinessEurope | Business federation support | seed docs | Position papers |
| DIGITALEUROPE | Digital industry advocate | seed docs | Position papers |
| Andreas Klinger | Vocal advocate (ex-AngelList) | W10 | Twitter |
| Philipp Herkelmann | EU-Inc manifesto contributor | seed docs | Manifesto |
| Dominik Hermle | Critical analysis ("Why EU Inc. Failed") | W09 | Substack |

## Industry Reaction

- Generally positive: viewed as "very strong signal" to founders and investors (W06-W08)
- Cautious optimism mixed with concerns about bureaucratic complexity (W08, W10)
- Warnings that EU committee processes could burden system with excessive requirements and notarization needs (W10)
- Comparisons to Delaware Inc and Stripe Atlas as successful models (W08)
- Some see it as too little too late (Hermle substack analysis, W09)

## Criticisms and Risks

- **Bureaucratic complexity:** EU committee processes may add excessive requirements (W10)
- **National sovereignty:** Some member states resist corporate law harmonization (seed docs)
- **Tax competition fears:** Potential race to bottom (seed docs)
- **Implementation complexity:** 27 legal systems to coordinate (seed docs)
- **Precedent concern:** Societas Europaea (existing pan-EU form) is underused and bureaucratic (seed docs)
- **"Why EU Inc. Failed" analysis:** Critical assessment by Dominik Hermle (W09-W10, HN)

## Open Questions

- Will draft legislation require unanimity or qualified majority voting?
- How will tax treatment be harmonized across member states?
- What will the relationship be between EU-Inc and existing Societas Europaea?
- When will an actual legislative proposal be published?
- How will IP and employment law be handled across jurisdictions?
- Will there be a transition period or pilot program?
